item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las b+hu ru drag po'i sku bstod rtags sgrub kyi rim pa
item.coloph: 'di las lhag pa'i gzhan na bon med do/ 'di ni rdo rje slob dpon thugs bcud yin// dbang chen phur pa'i sgrub pa zhes bya ba/ mkha' spyod zhing khams gsang ba'i yum cig gis/ phyag gis bum pa 'dzin shing snyan du brgyud/ kho bo 'phags btsun pad ma rje'i mtshan/ mkha' 'gro'i gnyer gtad bdag gis thub par byas/ de bzhin dus dang rkyen gyi rten 'brel las/ dmu btsun khun ldan 'gro ba gtsug gi rgyan/ slob dpon chen po gtsug phud tshul khrims kyis/ 'gro la phan phyir yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ phyi rabs don du zab mo yi ger bkod/ nyes 'gal ji mchis mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags/ dge ba thun mong byang chub spyi ru bsngo/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog ces gsungs so/ shing sbrul zla u0f1e tshes 24 bzang po la/ mdangs dar nyi ma'i gling du bkod pa dge legs 'phel//
